Communities Any grievances arising in the community, regarding Company’s operations, are communicated through direct representation to the HR Department or in other forms. Grievances reported are reviewed, addressed, and communicated suitably. If required the issue is escalated to Senior Management & MD for review.

Investors (other than shareholders) The Stakeholder Relationship Committee oversees and reviews all matters connected with the redressal of Investor Grievances and complaints. Investor grievances can be reported in the following e-mail ID, investor@ kitexgarments.com available on our company website.

Shareholders Shareholders grievances can be reported to RTA through the online investor portal of the RTA, ie, https:// wisdom.cameoindia.com/ and can also be reported to the Company through email ID, investor@kitexgarments. com
